name: orgforge
description: A governance layer for existing coding-agent teams: explicit roles, maker/checker boundaries, a non-skippable SDLC, human-held irreversible decisions, evidence records, and bounded organization evolution without replacing the Codex runtime.

interface.longDescription: Projects orgforge's neutral organizational governance onto Codex: explicit roles, SDLC phase gates, maker/checker separation, human-held irreversible decisions, evidence records, and bounded changes that let the organization evolve with the product. It uses the existing Codex runtime instead of introducing another agent framework.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use OrgForge governance for this repository: preserve ownership boundaries, follow the declared workflow, require independent checks, and record evidence.
